applied.problem: The rule of thumb drops the star (wye) condition its source [^10] states: in a delta connection the phase (winding) voltage equals the line voltage, so 'line = phase × √3' read alone in the dossier is too general.

Screen 12 asks for 'each phase' of a 440 V supply as 440 ÷ √3 without saying it is the phase-to-neutral voltage of a star supply; for a delta-connected or no-neutral ship supply, 254 V is not a phase voltage.
